text:
sam: Heads-up — customer asking for hardened private runtime (FIPS-enabled image + customer HSM). Two immediate asks: minimal RBAC for runtime->KMS shim, and a deny-by-default netpol pattern that still lets runtime talk to local agent. Also: conntrack/sysctl guidance and where to keep a runbook.

maria: Short: per-namespace ServiceAccount bound to a Role with only what the runtime needs (secrets:get + any discovery endpoints). Map the SA to the external HSM role (Encrypt/Decrypt; Sign only if attestation required). No cluster-admin.

devin: If possible, use unix domain socket for shim to avoid kernel conntrack. If shim is TCP on host, run it in a dedicated namespace or DaemonSet labeled app=kms-proxy and add a single egress rule to that label.

ash: Netpol pattern: default deny egress; allow egress from podSelector app=runtime to namespaceSelector role=kms-agent + podSelector app=kms-proxy. If agent uses hostNetwork, scope egress to node CIDR or node labels, not 0.0.0.0/0.

sre-jordan: Conntrack: rootless + high churn TCP connects can exhaust tables. Onboarding suggestion: recommend net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=131072 and monitor /proc/net/nf_conntrack. Prefer pooled long-lived connections or UDS. Include a synthetic test plan in docs.

ops-rita: Where to stash runbook? I propose private repo ops/runbooks/hsm-incident.md. Include steps: detect -> fail-closed for new decrypts -> surface metric kms.decrypt.failures -> notify customer HSM ops -> enable software-fallback behind feature flag -> rotate ephemeral keys if integrity is suspect -> rollback image if needed.

maria: Audit logging: emit structured JSON events with event_type, principal, resource_id_hashed (SHA2-256 in FIPS mode), action, outcome, ts. Never log keys or plaintext ciphertext. Mask identifiers per compliance.

sec-bot: CI check: any change to kms client requires kms-client risk review: https://redwood.internal/policies/kms-client-change :lock:

devin: Incident behaviour: fail closed for new decrypts (503) but continue serving non-sensitive cached responses. Emit dedicated metrics and escalate to infra then security on integrity indicators.

ash: Vuln triage note: found issue in upstream envelope lib — patch to v2.1.4 and prepare emergency image with software-fallback feature flag. Notify affected Private/Dedicated customers.

maria: Can someone drop two tiny snippets for onboarding (RBAC and netpol) I can paste?

sre-jordan: Copy-paste ready:
Role: namespace=customer-runtime, rules: secrets:get only; RoleBinding to runtime-sa.
NetworkPolicy: podSelector app=runtime; policyTypes: [Egress]; egress -> to namespaceSelector role=kms-agent & podSelector app=kms-proxy port 1812.

sam: Great — ops/rita will author runbook and a small PR with examples + conntrack test plan. If anyone can offer a cluster for the stress test (10k short TCP opens/minute), ping me. :raised_hands:
